title: Booking a climbing course
instructions: You are going to listen to a phone call between a young woman and the receptionist at a climbing centre. Complete the booking notes with the missing information. Write no more than three words or a number in each gap. You will hear the recording twice. There is an example (0) at the beginning.
instructionsHu: Telefonbeszélgetést hallasz egy fiatal nő és egy mászóterem recepciósa között. Egészítsd ki a foglalási jegyzetet a hiányzó adatokkal (legfeljebb három szó vagy egy szám). A felvételt kétszer hallod. A 0. a példa.

script.speaker: R
script.text: Good afternoon, Summit Climbing Centre, Mark speaking. How can I help you?

script.speaker: E
script.text: Hi. I'm calling about your climbing courses. My brother and I have never climbed before, so we're looking for something for complete beginners.

script.speaker: R
script.text: Then our Starter Course is perfect for you. It's on Saturday mornings, and you don't need any experience at all.

script.speaker: E
script.text: Great. How long is the course?

script.speaker: R
script.text: It's four sessions, one every Saturday. So that's four weeks.

script.speaker: E
script.text: And what time does it start?

script.speaker: R
script.text: Each session starts at half past ten and finishes at half past twelve. Oh, but please come ten minutes early on the first day, because there's a short safety talk.

script.speaker: E
script.text: OK, no problem. And how much does it cost?

script.speaker: R
script.text: The normal price is sixty pounds per person for the whole course. But are you students, by any chance?

script.speaker: E
script.text: Yes, we're both at college.

script.speaker: R
script.text: Then it's forty-five pounds each. You just need to show your student card on the first day.

script.speaker: E
script.text: That's much better. Do we need to bring any special equipment?

script.speaker: R
script.text: No, not at all. We give you a helmet and a rope, and climbing shoes are included in the price too. Just wear comfortable sports clothes. And, um, please don't wear jeans. They're terrible for climbing.

script.speaker: E
script.text: Good to know. So when does the next course start?

script.speaker: R
script.text: Let me have a look. The March course is already full, I'm afraid. The next one starts on the twelfth of April.

script.speaker: E
script.text: The twelfth of April. That's fine. Can I book two places, please?

script.speaker: R
script.text: Of course. Can I have your name?

script.speaker: E
script.text: Yes, it's Emily Fenwick.

script.speaker: R
script.text: Could you spell your surname for me, please?

script.speaker: E
script.text: Sure. It's F-E-N-W-I-C-K. People often forget the W, because you don't hear it.

script.speaker: R
script.text: F-E-N-W-I-C-K. Thank you. You can pay at reception on the first day, or online before then. Is there anything else?

script.speaker: E
script.text: Just one thing. Is there a café? My brother is always hungry.

script.speaker: R
script.text: There is, on the first floor. It's open until six every day, and climbers get ten percent off.

script.speaker: E
script.text: Perfect. Thanks so much for your help.

script.speaker: R
script.text: You're welcome, Emily. See you on the twelfth of April.

example.explanation: A Starter Course szombat délelőttönként van („on Saturday mornings”), tehát a nap: Saturday.

items.explanation: A helyes válasz: 4 (four). A recepciós szerint a tanfolyam négy alkalomból áll, minden szombaton egy.
items.evidence: It's four sessions, one every Saturday.

items.explanation: A helyes válasz: 10.30 (half past ten). Csapda: 12.30-kor ér véget, az első napon pedig tíz perccel korábban kell érkezni, de a kezdés időpontja fél tizenegy.
items.evidence: Each session starts at half past ten and finishes at half past twelve.

items.explanation: A helyes válasz: 45 (forty-five). Csapda: a normál ár 60 font, de diákoknak 45 font fejenként – ehhez az első napon a diákigazolványt kell megmutatni.

items.prompt: Included in the price: a helmet, a rope and ______
items.explanation: A helyes válasz: mászócipő (climbing shoes). A sisakot és a kötelet ők adják, és az árban a mászócipő is benne van.
items.evidence: climbing shoes are included in the price too

items.explanation: A helyes válasz: farmer (jeans). Kényelmes sportruhát kell viselni, farmert nem, mert az nagyon rossz mászáshoz („they're terrible for climbing”).

items.prompt: Start date of the next course: ______
items.explanation: A helyes válasz: április 12. (the twelfth of April). Csapda: a márciusi tanfolyam már betelt, ezért a következő, április 12-i kezdést választják.
items.evidence: The next one starts on the twelfth of April.

items.explanation: A helyes válasz: Fenwick. Emily betűzi a nevét (F-E-N-W-I-C-K), és figyelmeztet, hogy a W-t gyakran elfelejtik, mert nem hallatszik – ezért a „Fenick” rossz.
A helyes válasz: 6 óra (six). A kávézó az első emeleten van, és minden nap hatig van nyitva („open until six”).
items.evidence: It's open until six every day
